question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classicmodels.customers

question: List the names of all products in the Motorcycles product line.
gold_sql: SELECT productName FROM classicmodels.products WHERE productLine = 'Motorcycles'

question: Show the names of customers located in France.
gold_sql: SELECT customerName FROM classicmodels.customers WHERE country = 'France'

question: What is the product with the highest buy price? Show its name and buy price.
gold_sql: SELECT productName, buyPrice FROM classicmodels.products ORDER BY buyPrice DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the first and last names of all employees whose job title is Sales Rep.
gold_sql: SELECT firstName, lastName FROM classicmodels.employees WHERE jobTitle = 'Sales Rep'

question: How many orders have the status Cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classicmodels.orders WHERE status = 'Cancelled'

question: Show the cities of all offices located in the USA.
gold_sql: SELECT city FROM classicmodels.offices WHERE country = 'USA'

question: Which products have fewer than 100 units in stock? Show the product name and quantity in stock.
gold_sql: SELECT productName, quantityInStock FROM classicmodels.products WHERE quantityInStock < 100

question: List the names of customers whose sales rep works in the Paris office.
gold_sql: SELECT c.customerName FROM classicmodels.customers c JOIN classicmodels.employees e ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN classicmodels.offices o ON o.officeCode = e.officeCode WHERE o.city = 'Paris'

question: Show the names of the products in order number 10100.
gold_sql: SELECT p.productName FROM classicmodels.orderdetails od JOIN classicmodels.products p ON p.productCode = od.productCode WHERE od.orderNumber = 10100

question: Show the order number and status of every order placed by the customer 'Mini Gifts Distributors Ltd.'.
gold_sql: SELECT o.orderNumber, o.status FROM classicmodels.orders o JOIN classicmodels.customers c ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber WHERE c.customerName = 'Mini Gifts Distributors Ltd.'

question: For each sales rep, show their first name, last name and the number of customers they manage.
gold_sql: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, COUNT(*) FROM classicmodels.employees e JOIN classicmodels.customers c ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber GROUP BY e.employeeNumber, e.firstName, e.lastName

question: Which customers have never placed an order? Show their names.
gold_sql: SELECT c.customerName FROM classicmodels.customers c LEFT JOIN classicmodels.orders o ON o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber WHERE o.orderNumber IS NULL

question: Show the first and last names of employees who report directly to the President.
gold_sql: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName FROM classicmodels.employees e JOIN classicmodels.employees m ON m.employeeNumber = e.reportsTo WHERE m.jobTitle = 'President'

question: Which distinct product lines has the customer 'Euro+ Shopping Channel' bought?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.productLine FROM classicmodels.customers c JOIN classicmodels.orders o ON o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber JOIN classicmodels.orderdetails od ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber JOIN classicmodels.products p ON p.productCode = od.productCode WHERE c.customerName = 'Euro+ Shopping Channel'

question: Show the customer name and payment amount for every payment larger than 100000.
gold_sql: SELECT c.customerName, p.amount FROM classicmodels.payments p JOIN classicmodels.customers c ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber WHERE p.amount > 100000

question: What is the average credit limit of customers in each country? Show the country and the average.
gold_sql: SELECT country, AVG(creditLimit) FROM classicmodels.customers GROUP BY country

question: What is the total sales revenue (quantity ordered times price each) for each product line? Show the product line and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT p.productLine, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) FROM classicmodels.orderdetails od JOIN classicmodels.products p ON p.productCode = od.productCode GROUP BY p.productLine

question: Which 5 products sold the most units in total? Show the product name and total quantity ordered.
gold_sql: SELECT p.productName, SUM(od.quantityOrdered) AS total FROM classicmodels.orderdetails od JOIN classicmodels.products p ON p.productCode = od.productCode GROUP BY p.productCode, p.productName ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many employees work in each office? Show the office city and the number of employees.
gold_sql: SELECT o.city, COUNT(*) FROM classicmodels.offices o JOIN classicmodels.employees e ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode GROUP BY o.officeCode, o.city

question: Which countries have more than 10 customers? Show the country and the number of customers.
gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM classicmodels.customers GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

question: What is the total amount of all payments received?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM classicmodels.payments

question: Which customer has paid the most money in total? Show the customer name and the total paid.
gold_sql: SELECT c.customerName, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM classicmodels.payments p JOIN classicmodels.customers c ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerNumber, c.customerName ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders were placed in 2004?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classicmodels.orders WHERE YEAR(orderDate) = 2004

question: What is the total payment amount received in each year? Show the year and the total.
gold_sql: SELECT YEAR(paymentDate), SUM(amount) FROM classicmodels.payments GROUP BY YEAR(paymentDate)

question: List the order numbers of all orders placed in March 2005.
gold_sql: SELECT orderNumber FROM classicmodels.orders WHERE orderDate >= '2005-03-01' AND orderDate < '2005-04-01'

question: In 2003, which month had the most orders? Show the month number and the number of orders.
gold_sql: SELECT MONTH(orderDate) AS m, COUNT(*) AS n FROM classicmodels.orders WHERE YEAR(orderDate) = 2003 GROUP BY m ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders were shipped after their required date?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classicmodels.orders WHERE shippedDate > requiredDate

question: Show the 5 most recent payments with the customer name, payment date and amount.
gold_sql: SELECT c.customerName, p.paymentDate, p.amount FROM classicmodels.payments p JOIN classicmodels.customers c ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber ORDER BY p.paymentDate DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many different customers placed at least one order in 2005?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customerNumber) FROM classicmodels.orders WHERE YEAR(orderDate) = 2005
